stories.title: Trezor 警告 Safe 5 遭植入硬體竊聽板
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns of Hardware Implant in Safe 5 from Former Reseller
stories.summary: 印尼用戶從前經銷商 CryptoBilis 買到嘅 Safe 5 夾咗可經流動網絡外傳助記詞嘅電路板；Trezor 已斷絕合作並呼籲相關買家即時轉倉。
stories.summary_en: A Safe 5 bought via former reseller CryptoBilis hid a cellular implant that can exfiltrate the recovery phrase; Trezor cut ties and urges affected buyers to move funds.
stories.why_it_matters: 供應鏈植入直接打穿冷錢包假設；自託管用戶要核對來源同韌體。

stories.title: Polymarket 第三方腳本被入侵損失約 270 萬美元
stories.title_en: Polymarket Halts Trading After Third-Party Hack Drains $2.7 Million
stories.summary: DebugBear 監控腳本被植入惡意碼，登入 session 被盜後約一小時停市；平台已退款大部分用戶並補償交易損失。
stories.summary_en: A DebugBear monitoring script was injected; ~$2.7M drained via hijacked sessions before a trading halt; Polymarket refunded users and added trading-loss cover.
stories.why_it_matters: 金融站嵌第三方 JS 一樣有資金風險；預測市場同 DeFi 前端都受影響。

stories.title: Aave 於幣安被盜後重開借貸市場
stories.title_en: Aave Reopens Lending Markets After Binance Breach Freeze
stories.summary: 攻擊者向 Aave V3 注入約 6000 萬 USDT 並借入 WETH；Aave 曾凍結 16 網絡 292 儲備，其後分階段重開，部分資產暫設限制。
stories.summary_en: Attackers funneled ~$60M USDT into Aave V3 and borrowed WETH; Aave froze 292 reserves across 16 networks then reopened in stages with temporary limits.
stories.why_it_matters: DeFi 風控工具（凍結 vs 隔離市場）會影響借貸流動性同穩定幣溢價。

stories.title: Strategy 改以優先股籌資買 BTC
stories.title_en: Strategy Details Preferred Stock Shift for Bitcoin Buys Amid Earnings Volatility
stories.summary: Q3 業績會上宣布主力用 STRC 等數碼信貸買 BTC，普通股只在高於 1x mNAV 時為股息利息而賣；持倉約 84.85 萬 BTC。
stories.summary_en: Strategy will mainly fund BTC buys with preferred/digital credit like STRC, reserving common equity sales; holdings ~848,517 BTC.
stories.why_it_matters: 企業金庫買盤結構改變，影響 BTC 供應吸納同 MSTR 稀釋預期。

stories.title: 新加坡警方針對零售通路被改裝 Ledger
stories.title_en: Singapore Police Warn of Tampered Ledger Wallets in Retail Stores
stories.summary: 至少兩宗受害人從本地店舖買到植入惡意元件嘅 Ledger，損失約 270 萬美元；警方同 Ledger 呼籲核對包裝並直接向原廠購買。
stories.summary_en: Tampered Ledgers sold in some Singapore retail outlets stole seeds; ~$2.7M lost across victims; buy direct and verify packaging.
stories.why_it_matters: 東南亞零售硬體錢包供應鏈風險上升，同 Trezor 事件形成區域模式。

stories.title: Coinbase 上架 Ripple RLUSD 穩定幣
stories.title_en: Coinbase Lists Ripple's RLUSD Stablecoin for U.S. Users
stories.summary: 美區零售／交易所／Prime 均可 1:1 兌換；RLUSD 市值約 26 億、近 90 日淨流入逾 10 億，覆蓋 XRPL／ETH／Base。
stories.summary_en: Coinbase listed RLUSD across retail, exchange, and Prime; ~$2.6B mcap with strong inflows on XRPL, Ethereum, and Base.
stories.why_it_matters: 穩定幣競爭格局再變，影響兌換路徑同機構結算選擇。

stories.title: Anchorpoint 港元穩定幣 HKDAP 登陸 Solana
stories.title_en: Anchorpoint Brings HKD Stablecoin HKDAP to Solana Blockchain
stories.summary: 獲 HKMA 牌照嘅發行人把 HKDAP 由 ETH beta 擴到 Solana，近即時結算；渣打香港／HKT／Animoca  backing。
stories.summary_en: HKMA-licensed Anchorpoint expands HKDAP mint/redeem to Solana for near-instant settlement; Standard Chartered HK, HKT, Animoca backing.
stories.why_it_matters: 非美元穩定幣上 Solana，有利亞洲支付同 RWA 結算流動性。

stories.title: Solana RWA 規模破 51.9 億美元並接 Polygon
stories.title_en: Solana RWA Value Tops $5 Billion with Polygon Integration
stories.summary: 鏈上 RWA 由一年前不足 10 億升至約 51.9 億；Polygon Open Money Stack 接入 Solana，方便企業統一管理存款同穩定幣出金。
stories.summary_en: Solana RWA ~$5.19B; Polygon Open Money Stack adds Solana for unified deposits/stablecoin payouts across chains.
stories.why_it_matters: RWA／跨鏈支付基建成熟度上升，同 meme 盤資金面分流有關。

stories.title: Shopify 商家經 Coinbase 協議結算 4200 萬 USDC
stories.title_en: Shopify Merchants Settle $42 Million in USDC Payments via Coinbase Protocol
stories.summary: Base 上開源 Commerce Payments Protocol 讓合資格商家收穩定幣並定時兌本地法幣；已逾 44.8 萬筆、無 gas 體驗。
stories.summary_en: Shopify+Coinbase Commerce Payments Protocol on Base: $42M settled across 448k payments with gas covered for shoppers.
stories.why_it_matters: 穩定幣由轉帳走向日常消費結算，驗證零售需求。

stories.title: 代幣化股票市值達 46.3 億美元
stories.title_en: Tokenized Stocks Hit $4.63 Billion Milestone Echoing Early Stablecoins
stories.summary: 由年初不足 10 億急升；Binance bStocks／Ondo／xStocks 佔約 81%，BNB Chain 領先，DTCC 鏈上服務亦啟用。
stories.summary_en: Tokenized equities ~$4.63B YTD surge; bStocks/Ondo/xStocks ~81% share; DTCC on-chain service live with major banks.
stories.why_it_matters: 傳統資產上鏈規模接近早期穩定幣拐點敘事，影響交易所產品線。

stories.title: Ansem 在 Pumpfun 開大額 SOL 空單、$ANSEM 大跌
stories.title_en: Ansem Opens Big SOL Short on Pumpfun as $ANSEM Memecoin Drops 88%
stories.summary: 約 88 萬美元 10x SOL 空單；同名 meme 由峰值回落逾 88%；Pumpfun 新 perps 整合 Hyperliquid 受關注。
stories.summary_en: ~$880k 10x SOL short on Pumpfun perps; $ANSEM down >88% from peak; highlights new leveraged trading rail.
stories.why_it_matters: 網紅幣同永續槓桿合流，放大 meme 盤波動同清算風險。

stories.title: Solana 開發者因逆向 Pump.fun 合約收律師信
stories.title_en: Solana Developer Faces Cease-and-Desist for Reverse-Engineering Pump.fun Contracts
stories.summary: Shaw 公開 C&D，指要分析閉源合約安全風險；Bracket 引用版權同 ToS，社區討論逆向合法先例。
stories.summary_en: Dev Shaw got a C&D after reverse-engineering Pump.fun bytecode for security analysis; community cites fair-use precedents.
stories.why_it_matters: 閉源 launchpad 透明度爭議，影響用戶對 rug／合約風險嘅定價。

stories.title: 交易員 Frank 平倉逾千萬美元 meme 空單
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.summary: 平倉約 1230 萬槓桿空單（BTC／ZEC／NEAR／PUMP 等）鎖定利潤；指 meme 總市值由高峰 1500 億跌近 300 億。
stories.summary_en: Frank closed ~$12.3M leveraged shorts after memecoin cooldown; sector mcap cited ~$30B vs ~$150B peak.
stories.why_it_matters: 大戶平倉節奏反映 meme 風險偏好降溫，影響短線跟風盤。

stories.title: 比特幣佔比回落、山寨有輪動跡象
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Dominance Dips as Altcoins Show Signs of Surge
stories.summary: BTC.D 約 60.1%，alt 佔比回升；交易員談論資金輪動，altseason 指數仍中性約 56–59。
stories.summary_en: BTC dominance ~60.1% with talk of rotation into alts; altseason index still neutral ~56–59.
stories.why_it_matters: 佔比轉弱常伴隨山寨／meme 波動放大，係盤面風險偏好指標。

stories.title: 摩斯密碼提示注入令 AI 錢包代理被盜約 15–20 萬
stories.title_en: Morse Code Trick Drains $150K from AI Wallet Agent
stories.summary: 公開帖文隱藏指令經 Grok 轉譯後觸發 Bankrbot 轉帳；凸顯 AI agent 控錢包嘅 prompt injection 風險。
stories.summary_en: Hidden Morse instruction on X was decoded into a Bankrbot transfer of ~$150–200k; classic prompt-injection on AI wallet agents.
stories.why_it_matters: AI 代理一旦有簽名權，公開內容都能變成提款指令。

stories.title: 少年騙徒假冒客服盜 1300 萬 BTC 判 25 個月
stories.title_en: Teen Scammer Sentenced for $13M Bitcoin Heist via Fake Support Call
stories.summary: 加拿大籍 Trenton Johnston 冒充 Google／Trezor 客服騙取 185 BTC；已退還部分並被判 25 個月及遞解。
stories.summary_en: Teen scammer stole 185 BTC via fake Google/Trezor support; 25 months, partial restitution, deportation.
stories.why_it_matters: 社交工程仍然係大額自託管失竊主因，重申永不交出種子。

stories.title: 幣安被盜後社群玩梗叫黑客去搞 Pump.fun
stories.title_en: Crypto Users Urge Binance Hackers to Target Pump.fun
stories.summary: 約 63 億級熱錢包事件後，用戶以梗圖呼籲黑客下一步打 launchpad；幣安稱 SAFU 覆蓋、穩定幣方已凍部分贓款。
stories.summary_en: After the Binance hot-wallet breach, satirical posts urged hackers toward Pump.fun; Binance cited SAFU; stables froze part of loot.
stories.why_it_matters: 反映市場對低質 launchpad 嘅情緒，同時提醒中心化熱錢包風險。

stories.title: 幣安被盜後社群重提中本聰沉睡幣仍安全
stories.title_en: Satoshi's Untouched Bitcoin Hoard Stays Safe After Binance Hack
stories.summary: 對比交易所熱錢包失竊，中本聰約 109.6 萬 BTC 以早期原始私鑰存放、16 年未動，凸顯冷存儲韌性。
stories.summary_en: Contrast with exchange breach: Satoshi's ~1.096M BTC in early raw-key addresses untouched 16 years.
stories.why_it_matters: 強化「交易所託管 vs 自託管」風險敘事，影響資金進出所節奏。

stories.title: SPX6900 社群持續 DCA、市值仍約數億美元
stories.title_en: SPX6900 Memecoin Thrives on Relentless Community Positivity
stories.summary: 無團隊路線圖、靠文化同長期定投支撐；近有大額現貨買盤同數百日 DCA 打卡。
stories.summary_en: No-team culture meme with multi-hundred-day DCA ritual; recent large spot buys; mcap still hundreds of millions.
stories.why_it_matters: 長線社群 meme 同一日幣分流，觀察資金偏好類型。

stories.title: Starknet 基金會凍結幣安贓款中約 19 美元 STRK
stories.title_en: Starknet Foundation Freezes $19 of Stolen Funds in Binance Heist Response
stories.summary: 對比 Tether／Circle 凍結約 30 億，Starknet 迅速鎖 428 枚 STRK（約 $19）成社群梗，亦顯示鏈上凍結能力差異。
stories.summary_en: Starknet froze 428 STRK (~$19) from the Binance loot path; meme-worthy vs multi-billion stablecoin freezes.
stories.why_it_matters: 各鏈凍結／黑名單工具不對稱，影響贓款流動路徑。

stories.title: Chainalysis 披露客戶姓名電郵曾遭未授權存取
stories.title_en: Chainalysis Discloses Breach of Customer Names and Emails
stories.summary: 入侵者接觸非敏感聯絡資料；公司稱未見調查檔／密碼外洩，提醒提防釣魚；稱與幣安被盜無關。
stories.summary_en: An actor accessed non-sensitive contact data; no evidence investigation files or credentials were taken; unrelated to Binance theft; watch phishing.
stories.why_it_matters: 合規／追蹤基建出事會影響機構風控同執法節奏，短線情緒偏謹慎。

stories.title: 研究：Pump.fun 等發射台開發者優勢令多數交易者虧損
stories.title_en: Push for Fairer Token Launches Challenges Developer Advantages
stories.summary: 分析顯示開發者相關錢包常搶首塊；跨平台交易者平均虧損約 88.5%，Pump.fun 更高；有項目推 Activity Markets 替代。
stories.summary_en: Dev-linked wallets often buy first block; trader losses avg ~88.5% (higher on Pump.fun); Activity Markets proposed as alternative.
stories.why_it_matters: 發射台結構性劣勢解釋多數跟單虧損；本站堅持 Binance 現貨公開行情，唔跟 Dex meme 板。

stories.title: Injective Trench Treasury 買入 RunUp $RUNNER 約 5% 供應
stories.title_en: Injective's Trench Treasury Buys 5% of RunUp's $RUNNER Tokens
stories.summary: Treasury 長線持有發射台／永續聯動項目股份；RunUp 已擴至 Solana，並把費用導向買回與 $INJ 獎勵。
stories.summary_en: Trench Treasury took ~5% of $RUNNER long-term; RunUp expands to Solana with fee buybacks and $INJ rewards.
stories.why_it_matters: 公鏈財庫買 meme／發射台股權＝生態補貼訊號；短線價格仍睇流動性。

stories.title: 2FactorFinance 於 Base 推長線槓桿 BTC 敞口 beta
stories.title_en: 2FactorFinance Launches Beta for Long-Term Leveraged Exposure on Base
stories.summary: 以 Kelly 準則拆高級／初級份額，瞄準多月持有而非日內槓桿；避開借貸與日衰減問題。
stories.summary_en: Public beta on Base splits assets into senior/junior tranches via Kelly criterion for multi-month leveraged exposure without daily decay.
stories.why_it_matters: 長線槓桿產品改變風險結構；紙上倉唔好把短炒止蝕邏輯套上去。

stories.title: Murad：AGI 時代 meme 社群或跑贏效用型代幣
stories.title_en: Memecoins Seen Outlasting Utility Tokens in AGI Era
stories.summary: 指 AGI 可自動化代碼效用，但難複製社群文化與線下聚會；SPX6900 等被視為例子。
stories.summary_en: Murad argues community memecoins may outperform utility tokens once AGI automates code-based models.
stories.why_it_matters: 敘事偏長線信念盤；短線仍要睇流動性同廣度，唔好當即時買訊。

stories.title: X 用戶拆解 Pump.fun 跟單神話：多數模擬仍虧
stories.title_en: X Users Expose Memecoin Trading Myths on Pump.fun
stories.summary: 對網紅叫單做回測，$100 跟單常變成數十美元；同時有地址一日部署數百幣。
stories.summary_en: Simulations of influencer Pump.fun calls often lose; serial deployers launch hundreds of tokens daily.
stories.why_it_matters: 跟單發射台勝率極低；本站只跟 Binance 公開現貨，避開 Dex meme 板。

stories.title: $GTA6 meme 急升後崩；社群質疑錢包集群造勢
stories.title_en: GTA VI Memecoin Surges Then Crashes Amid Wallet Cluster Suspicions
stories.summary: 單一錢包兩分鐘倒貨約 14.6 萬美元致急跌約 64%；頂倉錢包開戶時間接近，疑似協調買盤。
stories.summary_en: A ~$146k dump in under two minutes sparked a ~64% crash; clustered young wallets raised bot/hype suspicions.
stories.why_it_matters: 主題 meme 易被集群錢包製造動能；追升前要睇持倉年齡同集中度。

stories.title: BULK 轉型多鏈交易 Layer 1；社群同 Solana 陣營意見分裂
stories.title_en: BULK Shifts to Multi-Chain Trading Layer 1
stories.summary: 永續平台計劃讓用戶由多鏈存入、共用訂單簿再任意提走；Anatoly 偏向原生 Solana 項目。
stories.summary_en: BULK pivots to a multi-chain L1 shared order book; Solana cofounder favors native Solana projects.
stories.why_it_matters: 永續流動性遷移敘事影響 SOL 生態資金；短線價格仍睇大盤。
